summary: Both new Huber lemmas re-derive `TauCeti.Huber.IsTateRing.eq_top_of_isOpen` / `isOpen_iff_eq_top` (OpenIdeal.lean), one with a verbatim copy of the existing proof body. `isClosed_setOfPred_forall_vle_zero` duplicates the argument already inlined in `isClosed_support_locus` and is used nowhere, and the neighbourhood block in `cont_eq_empty_of_one_mem_closure_zero` re-derives `IsContinuous.sub_lt_mem_nhds`.
